description:

title: Senior Solution Engineer - GCC
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for world-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.

The Solution Engineer will work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.

The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

- Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

- Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

- Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

- Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side

- Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake

- Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits

- Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions

- Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption

- Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events

- Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories & case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake

Este rol forma parte del equipo de Investment de WPP Media, donde entre otras cosas, estamos a cargo de las negociaciones y auditorías de un grupo de clientes clave para la agencia. Este cargo es una pieza fundamental en el control de márgenes y rentabilidad de medios propios, que se basan en los lineamientos definidos por la agencia.

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios ( Be Extraordinary ), invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. Creamos un Entorno Abierto ( Create an Open Environment ) basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Egy olyan jövőért dolgozunk, ahol a kisebb vállalkozások is sikeresen működhetnek és ugyanolyan elkötelezettséggel támogatjuk őket, amilyennel ők nap mint nap építik a közösségünket.

Legyél a történetünk része!
Kivételes tehetségeket keresünk, akik csatlakoznának küldetésünkhöz. Nálunk lehetőséged van valódi hatást gyakorolni egy lendületes, összetartó közösségben. Támogatunk a folyamatos fejlődésben, büszkék vagyunk közös céljainkra, és átfogó juttatási csomagot kínálunk.

Csatlakozz csapatunkhoz, mint független értékesítő!

Proaktív személy vagy, aki szeret emberekkel beszélgetni és sok időt tölteni terepen? Kiváló kommunikációs készségeid vannak és szereted az értékesítést? Széles kapcsolati hálóval rendelkezel a vendéglátásban, kiskereskedelemben és a szépségiparban, vagy egyszerűen csak ismersz valakit szinte bármire?

A Teya-nál folyamatosan keressük azokat a független értékesítőket, akik képviselik szolgáltatásainkat kis- és középvállalkozások számára a fizetési megoldások területén.
A feladat egyszerű: találj egy ügyfelet, küldj neki ajánlatot, vidd fel felhasználóként, és a jutalék hamarosan a számládon landol.

Van saját céged vagy egyéni vállalkozásod? Remek! A vállalkozásod a hónap során általad hozott ügyfelek után számláz a Teya felé, így a bevételed teljes mértékben az általad elért eredményektől függ.

Miért dolgozz velünk:

- Korlátlan kereseti lehetőség: Teljesítményalapú, magas jutalékrendszer, korlátlan potenciállal

- Függetlenség: Szabadság a saját vállalkozásod vezetésére, miközben igénybe veheted támogatásunkat és erőforrásainkat

- Kiváló megoldások: Dolgozz a legmodernebb kártyaelfogadó technológiával és POS eszközökkel

- Képzés és támogatás: Részletes képzést biztosítunk, hogy minél jobban megismerd szolgáltatásainkat, és folyamatos támogatást nyújtunk minden felmerülő kérdésre

Amit tőled várunk:

- Kiváló kommunikációs és prezentációs készségek

- Önálló munkavégzés és hatékony időgazdálkodás

Ha mindez jól hangzik, és szeretnél a saját feltételeid szerint dolgozni korlátlan kereseti lehetőséggel, örömmel várjuk jelentkezésedet!

A Teya elkötelezett az egyenlő esélyek biztosítása mellett.
Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. title: Senior Revenue Integrity Analyst (GOVT)

Overview
The Sr. Revenue Integrity Analyst owns advanced revenue analysis and key month-end controls that support accurate invoicing, revenue application, inventory reconciliation, revenue cycle processes, and financial reporting within the complex chart review business function. This role investigates revenue leakage, applies revenue, manages revenue SLAs, analyzes inventory and financial variances, and leads resolution of invoice and client issues. The role develops actionable reporting, partners across functions to correct root causes, and mentors junior analysts.
Responsibilities

• Own month-end revenue validation controls, including reconciliation of outputs, exceptions, adjustments, open inventory, and close support schedules.

• Investigate potential missed, delayed, misstated, or incorrectly billed revenue using paid claim transactional data, invoice detail, contractual terms, and internal financial records. Compares disparate data sources to uncover and apply missed opportunity.

• Perform and oversee reconciliation of client self-billing files, including data transformation, loading, quality verification, exception analysis, and final invoice support.

• Review invoicing accuracy and contract alignment; apply non-standard contractual pricing and resolve discrepancies, disputes, and fee paybacks. Support appropriate closure of inventory.

• Analyze period-over-period movement, inventory aging, throughput, financial data, and other financial variances.

• Identify root causes of financial underperformance and communicate findings, revenue impact, options, and recommended corrective actions in formal business settings.

• Lead invoice-detail questions and escalations with internal and external stakeholders; prepare facts and resolution recommendations for complex client issues.

• As needed develop recurring reports, dashboards, forecasts, and insights that monitor KPI and SLA performance, revenue risk, service delivery, and financial accuracy.

• Partner with Finance, Operations, Technology, and Engineering to reconcile inventory and correct invoicing or revenue application system and process issues.

• Use Power BI, automation, and agentic tools to improve analytical quality, control effectiveness, cycle time, and operating efficiency.

• Mentor junior analysts and establish consistent approaches for reconciliations, investigations, documentation, and escalation.

• Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.

• Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.

• Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.
Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, professional training, and relevant work experience. High school diploma or GED required.

• 5-8 years’ experience in finance, accounting, healthcare payment integrity, revenue cycle or related fields.

• Strong experience in revenue integrity, revenue cycle management, invoice standards, financial and accounting best practices, inventory management, healthcare payment integrity, and healthcare claims processing.

• Ability to own multistep month-end controls and resolve complex discrepancies across client-supplied files, invoice detail, and internal financial systems.

• Advanced Excel and data-analysis skills; proficiency developing reports and insights in Power BI or similar business intelligence tools.

• Working knowledge of healthcare payment integrity, claims proces

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced PeopleSoft Integration Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integrations connecting PeopleSoft applications to internal systems, cloud applications, and third-party platforms. This role focuses specifically on the integration layer, including service operations, queues, routings, transformations, security configurations, and error handling. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on Integration Broker experience with broader PeopleTools knowledge and a strong understanding of API and integration design patterns. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

• Design and develop integration scenarios using PeopleSoft Integration Broker, including service operations, queues, routings, and handlers.

• Build synchronous and asynchronous integrations using REST and SOAP web services.

• Develop transformations using XSLT, Application Engine, and PeopleCode handlers, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.

• Build robust error-handling and retry mechanisms, including notifications, monitoring, and resubmission workflows.

• Develop Component Interfaces and File Layouts to support hybrid integration scenarios.

• Lead migration efforts to retire legacy point-to-point integrations to standardized Integration Broker patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.

• Optimize performance of high-volume integrations through queue tuning, parallel processing, and asynchronous design.

• Integrate PeopleSoft with cloud applications (Oracle Cloud, Workday, ServiceNow) and middleware (OIC, MuleSoft, Boomi).

• Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation - including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures - so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

• Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, including incident response and root-cause analysis.

• Collaborate closely with functional consultants and integration architects, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.

• Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato .

YOUR ROLE
You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.
Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.
We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.
By the end of your first year:

• Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier

• Carrier conversion data running in production models

• Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale

• A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions

• Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives

• Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

• 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact

• Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.

• You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included

• You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift

• You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view

• Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

• Real ad budget spent in live auctions

• Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems

• Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms

• Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration

• Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior

• AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker

• CI/CD deployment

title: SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, United Kingdom
description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, United Kingdom
Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in the United Kingdom. Day rate: GBP 400 a day, inside IR35. Language: English.
The programme
A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.
You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.
What you will work on
Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.
What you bring
8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.
Useful but not essential:
SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
description: THE POSITION ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory. This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented. Missions : Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge). Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods. Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup. Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods. You will work at the crossroads of electromagnetics, imaging and deep learning, with the engineers of the Innovation team. description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails,  wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

This is a hands-on treasury role sitting at the centre of how Yellow Card moves money. You will be responsible for making sure liquidity is where it needs to be, in the right currency, across our banks, liquidity providers, and offshore accounts, so that payouts, settlements, and trades are never held up for lack of funds. Day to day, that means moving capital between accounts, executing wires and stablecoin trades, and reacting fast when a payment is blocked because an account has run dry. You will report to the Head of Liquidity & Custody and work alongside the team's Senior Liquidity and Pricing Specialist, who owns rate-setting and forecasting; this role owns execution, getting the money where it needs to be, accurately and on time.

What You'll Do

Liquidity & Cash Management:

• Execute offshore and local fund movements between Yellow Card's banks and liquidity providers to keep accounts funded for USD, EUR, GBP and other local-currency payouts.

• Monitor account balances daily across banks and liquidity providers, and top up accounts proactively rather than waiting for a payment to be blocked.

• Initiate wires, ACH, and SWIFT transfers across our banking partners within approval limits.

• Trade with liquidity providers to convert stablecoin to fiat (and fiat to stablecoin) to rebalance exposure and fund payouts, locking rates directly with liquidity provider trading desks where needed.

• Assist with liquidity movements, planning and projections, and the management of capital cycles and repayments.

Banking & Liquidity Partner Relationships:

• Act as the day-to-day point of contact for Yellow Card's liquidity providers and banking partners across our African markets, the US, the UK and EU.

• Coordinate wallet whitelisting and clean-up with liquidity providers whenever banking or wallet infrastructure changes.

• Monitor counterparty exposure and settlement risk on liquidity partners, and escalate access, settlement, or counterparty issues promptly.

Settlement, Reconciliation & Reporting:

• Reconcile liquidity provider and bank statements against internal records to ensure accuracy.

• Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks and balance discrepancies, including trades executed directly with liquidity providers outside of standard portal statements.

• Collect and maintain monthly liquidity provider statements to support month-end close.

• Maintain accurate, complete records of all fund movements and payment transactions.

• Support treasury risk reporting by generating treasury dashboards covering liquidity. 

Ad Hoc & Cross-Functional Support:

• Process and review customer refunds.

• Support funding approvals for opex and payroll liquidity needs.

• Partner with Finance, Compliance, and Product/Engineering on liquidity-impacting issues, incidents, or new market and product launches.

• Document processes as you run them and cross-train with other members of the Liquidity team, so day-to-day execution never depends on one person alone.

What We Are Looking For

• Experience: Hands-on experience in treasury or liquidity operations experience at a crypto exchange, stablecoin/fintech company, or financial institution and are able to step directly into daily execution with minimal ramp-up.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. - Tailor the introduction of new solutions to specific customer needs.

- Conduct research and analysis on customers and competitors.

Primary Function
Long Wave Inc. is seeking a Senior Principal Quality Engineer - Program Quality Assurance (PRQA) to support program execution, contractual quality compliance, and Quality Management System (QMS) activities within an aerospace and defense environment.
Essential Responsibilities
Program Quality Assurance & Contractual Compliance

• Serve as lead PRQA for assigned programs, providing quality oversight throughout program development, production, testing, integration, and acceptance.

• Review and analyze contracts, Statements of Work (SOW), Supplier Quality Assurance Requirements (SQAR), purchase orders, specifications, and other customer requirements to identify quality obligations, compliance gaps, and risks.

• Serve as a senior technical resource for complex aerospace and defense quality engineering, customer quality requirements, and compliance matters across the organization.

• Provide technical guidance and recommendations to Quality Assurance, Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Supply Chain Management, and other functional organizations.

• Lead or support complex cross-functional quality investigations, risk assessments, and improvement initiatives.

• Evaluate existing quality processes, systems, and controls; recommend and implement improvements to strengthen compliance, effectiveness, and operational performance.

• Provide technical mentoring, coaching, and knowledge transfer to quality personnel and other functional stakeholders.

• Advise Quality leadership on complex quality concerns, technical risks, and opportunities for improvement.

QMS Compliance & Continuous Improvement

• Support implementation, sustainment, and continual improvement of the AS9100/ISO 9001 Quality Management System.

title: Senior Google Media Buyer (Contract, Full-time)
description:
Senior Google Media Buyer MVR Digital | Remote | Full-Time
About MVR Digital

MVR Digital is a performance marketing agency recognized by Adweek as one of the Fastest Growing Agencies. We manage paid media for growth-stage DTC and e-commerce brands spending $100K to $1M+ monthly across Meta, Google, TikTok, and more.
We're remote-first with roots in New York, Denver, and Canada. Our clients come to us after being burned by agencies that overpromise. They stay because we own outcomes and tell them the truth.
The Role
You'll manage Google Ads campaigns across multiple e-commerce and DTC accounts, working closely with strategists and client success. This role is non-client-facing, but it's not purely executional either.
We want someone who understands Google's ecosystem well enough to have opinions. You know when the campaign structure is working against the algorithm, when Performance Max is cannibalizing Search, and when the bidding strategy needs a reset. You bring that thinking to the team, and you execute on it with precision.
EST hours preferred, with required overlap from 10 AM to 1 PM EST. As the agency scales, strong buyers get access to larger and more complex accounts.
What You'll Do

• Own Google Ads execution across e-commerce accounts, including Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube, and Demand Gen

• Monitor daily pacing and performance, adjusting budgets and bids as needed

• Troubleshoot issues quickly and execute optimizations without waiting to be prompted

• Contribute strategic input on account structure, testing approach, and campaign architecture

• Run structured tests across bidding strategies, audiences, and creative formats

• Stay current on Google platform changes, algorithm behavior, and best practices, and apply them proactively

• Maintain tracking integrity across GA4, GTM, and conversion events, and flag data quality issues before they affect decisions

• Build and maintain Looker Studio reporting that gives the CSM and strategist what they need without extra asks

• Maintain clean campaign structures, naming conventions, and documentation across all accounts

• Collaborate in Slack and ClickUp to stay aligned with strategists and client success

What You Bring
Google (Required)

• 4+ years of hands-on Google Ads buying experience for DTC or e-commerce brands

• Deep expertise across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and YouTube, including the strategic rationale behind each

• Strong understanding of Google's machine learning systems and how campaign structure decisions affect them

• Experience managing accounts with $100K+ monthly ad spend across multiple accounts simultaneously

• Ability to diagnose performance issues at the structural, bidding, and creative level

• Solid command of GA4, GTM, conversion tracking setup, and attribution windows

• Current on Google platform changes and able to translate them into account decisions

• E-commerce background

Nice to Have

• Meta Ads experience for DTC or e-commerce brands

• TikTok Ads Manager experience

• Microsoft Ads experience

Working Style

• You work autonomously and follow through without reminders

• You bring observations and recommendations, not just status updates

• You communicate clearly in writing in an async-first environment

• You flag performance shifts before they show up on someone else's radar

How We Work
Our values shape how we operate day to day, not just what we put on a website.

• Act Like an Owner. You spot problems and bring solutions. Waiting to be told is not the standard.

• Clarity Over Complexity. Clean structures, clear communication, simple systems. If it's complicated, we make it simpler.

• Serve Clients' Best Interest. Your execution directly fuels client outcomes. That connection matters here.

• Data-Informed, Human-Led. Numbers guide decisions. Judgment closes them.

• We Win Together, We Lose Together. Strategists, creatives, and buyers succeed as a unit. Credit and accountability are shared.

ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the local and cloud sandboxed environments that make interactive and autonomous agentic workflows trustworthy by default. At the heart of our trust model is the fact that user credentials and other sensitive secrets are injected at the sandbox layer and never exposed to an agent. An agent can never leak secrets it never sees.

The Secrets team builds the software that makes that possible, from easy-to-use SDKs to secure cloud services to high-performance network proxies. We operate at the intersection of the developer experience, enterprise governance, and security - delivering core security features that make Docker sandboxes the best way to run agents and other workloads safely.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Secrets team, you’ll design and build core security systems that power Docker’s agentic platform and AI governance products. Your work will focus on creating scalable, reliable, and secure software that enables developers to safely run agentic workloads while allowing administrators to confidently manage their organization’s security posture.

The successful candidate is a technical, product-minded engineer with deep experience building secure software and scale-out cloud services and a track record of shipping critical infrastructure. They think naturally about isolation and security boundaries, understand the tradeoffs involved in running untrusted or semi-trusted workloads safely, and can reason confidently about a system that spans multiple surface areas.

If you thrive on solving security and usability challenges, are enthusiastic about agentic development but conscious of the risks it entails, and want to help shape the future of Docker’s platform, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Business Development Manager (Commercial Kitchen Supplier) remote (Remote , GB)
description:
About Franke

We, the Franke company with its three divisions, are a world's leading supplier of products and services for domestic kitchens, the professional foodservice systems and the convenience store sector as well as for professional coffee making. With around 60 companies, we are at home on five continents. Over 8,000 employees constantly take on new perspectives to identify opportunities and turn them into inspiring, innovative solutions for tomorrow’s demands.

The Franke Foodservice Systems division is a world-leading supplier of kitchen facilities, equipment and supplies solutions. As a full system manufacturer, distributor and program management partner, we supply global chains in the quick-service restaurant, convenience store and supermarket segments, helping to manage unit growth and upgrade their facilities.

About the job

Your mission is to build strong commercial relationships with leading QSR brands while helping us sustainably grow our market share.

You will develop and grow long-term customer partnerships, ensuring they have the right equipment, components, and solutions to maintain efficient commercial kitchens.

From everyday operational items to major equipment, you will be the trusted partner behind their success.

In this role, you will help ensure that some of the world’s most recognized restaurant brands operate seamlessly - every day.

Your tasks

• Build and nurture long-term relationships with key customers in the QSR and HoReCa sector

• Manage and grow existing accounts, ensuring customer retention and expansion

• Identify customer needs and recommend tailored foodservice solutions and equipment

• Proactively sell utensils, components and equipment to prevent operational disruptions

• Identify and acquire new customers, leveraging market insights and industry knowledge

• Lead sales negotiations, close contracts, and consistently achieve targets

Requirements

• Proven experience in B2B sales, ideally in: QSR / HoReCa / Gastronomy or technical installations

• Previous QSR experience in field operations and/or training is a plus

• Strong track record in account development and long-term relationship management

• Confident negotiation and closing skills

• Ability to understand and communicate technical specifications of equipment

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Highly organized, proactive, and customer-centric mindset

• Willingness to travel frequently (~50%)

• Valid Category B driving licence

• University degree (Bachelor’s/Master’s) is a plus

What we offer you

High-performing Sales Representatives have the opportunity to grow into advanced roles, such as:

• Market Manager

• Business Development Manager

• Key Account Manager

We offer you not just an exciting role, but also:

• Flexible working hours and modern mobile work options

• Attractive compensation package with performance‑based bonuses

• High‑quality equipment (company car, laptop, mobile phone)

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee health and wellness programs

• Participation in trade fairs, industry events, and networking activities

• A supportive and motivated team committed to your success

Contact details

Nadja Günthard, Global Head Recruiting & Talent

For more information see:

Important information for all executive search companies, headhunters and HR consultants
The Franke Group does not accept unsolicited support from headhunters and personnel consultants for our career opportunities. Any CV/resume vitae submitted to Franke or its employees by external recruitment agencies without a valid written recruitment agreement related to the position in question shall be deemed the sole property of our company. In the event that a candidate presented by an agency is hired in our company and there is no prior agreement, no fee will be paid.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer - Product Metrics (EMEA Remote)
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Product Metrics team owns the collection, storage, and serving of metrics collected from customers' ClickHouse instances. As a part of the team you will be responsible for designing, building, operating and maintaining components of the petabyte-scale platform that stores trillions of records and processes millions of new events every second, owning its reliability, performance and availability. Our stack is built using Golang, runs in Kubernetes, and is, of course, stored in ClickHouse. The team’s responsibilities include gathering and processing data for the internal billing and accounting system as well as customer-facing dashboards that provide our customers with immediate insights and analytics. The Product Metrics system is specifically designed to prioritize delivery guarantees, precision, and accuracy in handling extensive data volumes. Its primary goal is to provide data that is both prompt and accurate, supporting reliable operational decisions and enhancing the overall customer experience.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

- Take an active part in determining the roadmap for the Product Metrics team

- Work closely within the team to deliver new features, iterate and improve them

- Design, build, operate, and maintain business-critical petabyte-scale systems

- Be responsible for the performance, reliability, availability and cost-efficiency of the Product Metrics systems

- Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team

- Be a part of on-call rotation and take ownership of the services you're running

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR IN YOU?

- You demonstrate a strong initiative and a preference for action, high level of responsibility, ownership and accountability

- You prioritize customer needs, ensuring that our products are designed with the user in mind

- You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively

- You have a strong problem solving mindset and have solid production debugging skills

- You have excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and across engineering teams in a fully remote environment

- You thrive in a fast-paced environment, and see yourself as a partner with the business with the shared goal of moving the business forward

REQUIREMENTS:

- 5+ years of relevant software development industry experience building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems

- 2+ years of software application development experience using Golang

- Experience with at least one of the major Cloud Service Providers such as AWS, GCP or Azure

- Experience with storing, shipping, and retrieving large volumes of data efficiently using technologies such as ClickHouse 

- Experience with technologies such as Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, Temporal as well as infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform

BONUS POINTS:

- Experience with ClickHouse

- Experience writing Kubernetes operators or controllers

- Experience with Kafka streaming technology 

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings - We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhous
